entities.summary: Shigeru Umebayashi (b. 1951-02-19, Kitakyūshū-shi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kitakyūshū-shi and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
